card.name: Inside bacterial species names
card.fires_on: Partway through a bacterial genus name, especially the period after an abbreviated genus like E. or C., or the middle of names like Yersinia and Acinetobacter. Also seen in reference-list punctuation in infection papers.

modes.description: The period after a single-letter genus such as E or C, right before the species name.
